nina: FYI scheduling a quick kernel patch tonight 02:00 UTC: v2.14.1-hotfix + quant qf-2026-03c. Hotfix addresses rare kv-cache write-through race seen in perf runs. Rollout: 0.5% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 5m holds. auto-pin if 5xx >0.3% for 4m.

deploybot: job=deploy-5191234567 preflight=01:30 UTC. will run prebake and smoke. /status for updates.

omar: note: matmul ABI unchanged; this is only kv write timing fix. still check kv-miss and eviction counts.

kate: SRE please watch p99 and 5xx closely during first 10m after each promote. I can hold the cross-region step if anything odd.

eng-sre-bot: preflight PASSED 01:31 UTC. prebake ok, smoke ok. checksum OK.

deploybot: canary 0.5% started 02:00:08 UTC. metrics: https://internal.redwood/metrics/deploy-5191234567

omar: quick harness on canary node shows kv-consistency OK. no evictions.

kate: thumbs-up, promote to 10% after 5m if metrics stable.

deploybot: promoted to 10% 02:05:30 UTC. holding 5m.

nina: if anything spikes, use `deploybot pin set --id deploy-5191234567 --ttl 2h --scope region-all` to freeze.

eng-sre-bot: 02:10 UTC check: p99 +1.2%, 5xx flat, kv-miss unchanged. clear to continue.

deploybot: promoted to 50% 02:11:22 UTC, final promote to 100% pending 5m hold.

kate: no objections, final promote at 02:16 UTC if still green.

deploybot: roll to 100% complete 02:16:10 UTC. summary: no auto-pins, no rollbacks. RN note: "hotfix for kv write race, no user-facing impact observed."

nina: thanks everyone. Ill file a short post-deploy note in #release-notes and bake for 30m.
